  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(iconifyr)
library(htmltools)

# The icons on this page were fetched with iconify_get() and stored in
# gallery-snapshot.json, so building the site makes no API calls (the public
# API rate limits shared CI addresses). To refresh the snapshot, run
#   ICONIFYR_RECORD_GALLERY=true Rscript -e 'rmarkdown::render("vignettes/icon-gallery.Rmd")'
store_file <- "gallery-snapshot.json"
record <- identical(Sys.getenv("ICONIFYR_RECORD_GALLERY"), "true")
live <- identical(Sys.getenv("ICONIFYR_LIVE_VIGNETTES"), "true")
store <- if (file.exists(store_file) && !record) {
  jsonlite::fromJSON(store_file, simplifyVector = TRUE)
} else {
  list()
}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", eval = record || live || length(store) > 0)

# Return a stored value, or fetch it (and store it when recording).
snap <- function(key, fetch) {
  if (is.null(store[[key]])) {
    store[[key]] <<- fetch()
    if (record) {
      options(iconifyr.cache = FALSE)
      jsonlite::write_json(store, store_file, auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE)
    }
  }
  store[[key]]
}

sets_used <- c(
  "mdi", "tabler", "lucide", "ph", "bi", "carbon", "fa6-solid",
  "fa6-brands", "simple-icons", "logos", "twemoji", "flat-color-icons"
)
sets <- if (knitr::opts_chunk$get("eval")) {
  snap("sets", function() {
    all <- iconify_sets()
    all[match(sets_used, all$prefix), ]
  })
}

icon_cell <- function(id, size = 40, color = NULL, flip = NULL, rotate = NULL) {
  key <- paste(id, size, color, flip, rotate, sep = "|")
  svg <- snap(key, function() {
    iconify_get(id, size = size, color = color, flip = flip, rotate = rotate)
  })
  tags$span(
    title = id,
    style = "display: inline-block; margin: 0 0.6em 0.4em 0;",
    HTML(svg)
  )
}

gallery <- function(spec) {
  rows <- lapply(names(spec), function(p) {
    info <- sets[sets$prefix == p, ]
    tags$tr(
      tags$td(tags$strong(info$name), tags$br(), tags$code(p)),
      tags$td(info$license_spdx),
      tags$td(lapply(paste0(p, ":", spec[[p]]), icon_cell))
    )
  })
  tags$table(
    class = "table",
    tags$thead(tags$tr(tags$th("Icon set"), tags$th("License"), tags$th("Icons"))),
    tags$tbody(rows)
  )
}
```

Iconify hosts 240+ icon sets behind one API. The icons below come from 12 of
them, each fetched with `iconify_get()`. Hover over an icon to see its id. The
table helper (`gallery()`) is defined in this article's source.

## Same idea, different sets

Seven sets, each with its own drawing style and license. Monotone icons take the
surrounding text color, so they follow light and dark themes.

```{r same-idea}
gallery(list(
  mdi = c("home", "rocket-launch", "chart-line", "github"),
  tabler = c("brand-github", "map-pin", "leaf", "bolt"),
  lucide = c("camera", "sun", "leaf", "map"),
  ph = c("airplane", "tree", "map-pin", "chart-bar"),
  bi = c("globe", "tree", "bicycle", "graph-up"),
  carbon = c("earth", "chart-line", "map", "tree"),
  `fa6-solid` = c("tree", "earth-americas", "chart-simple", "bicycle")
))
```

## Brand logos

```{r brands}
gallery(list(
  `fa6-brands` = c("r-project", "github", "python", "docker"),
  `simple-icons` = c("rstudioide", "quarto", "github", "posit"),
  logos = c("r-lang", "github-icon", "python", "docker-icon")
))
```

## Multicolor sets

`color` only recolors monotone icons. Emoji and flat-color sets keep their own
palette.

```{r multicolor}
gallery(list(
  twemoji = c("globe-showing-americas", "seedling", "bar-chart", "rocket"),
  `flat-color-icons` = c("globe", "combo-chart", "camera")
))
```

## Color, size, flip and rotate

One icon, many variations:

```{r variations}
id <- "mdi:rocket-launch"
tags$div(
  icon_cell(id, color = "#e63946"),
  icon_cell(id, color = "#2a9d8f"),
  icon_cell(id, color = "#457b9d", size = 64),
  icon_cell(id, color = "#f4a261", flip = "horizontal"),
  icon_cell(id, color = "#8d5fd3", rotate = 90),
  icon_cell(id, color = "#264653", rotate = 180, flip = "vertical")
)
```

```r
iconify_html("mdi:rocket-launch", color = "#f4a261", flip = "horizontal")
iconify_html("mdi:rocket-launch", color = "#8d5fd3", rotate = 90)
```

## Pick an icon from search results

```r
hits <- iconify_search("rocket", prefixes = c("mdi", "tabler", "ph", "lucide"), limit = 32)
head(hits, 8)
```

```{r search, echo = FALSE}
ids <- snap("search:rocket", function() {
  iconify_search("rocket", prefixes = c("mdi", "tabler", "ph", "lucide"), limit = 32)$id[1:8]
})
parts <- strsplit(ids, ":", fixed = TRUE)
hits <- data.frame(
  id = ids,
  prefix = vapply(parts, `[`, "", 1),
  name = vapply(parts, `[`, "", 2)
)
hits
tags$div(lapply(ids, icon_cell, size = 36))
```

## Credits

Using an icon means following its set's license. `iconify_sets()` lists the
license and author of every set, which is enough for a credit line:

```{r credits}
credits <- sets
credits$attribution <- ifelse(grepl("^(CC-BY|ODbL)", credits$license_spdx), "required", "-")
credits[c("prefix", "name", "author", "license_title", "attribution")]
```

`iconify_license()` returns the same data for one set, plus the license and
author URLs, and prints a message when attribution is required.
